thread:
sam: Heads up — deploybot put the promotion for release/v2.4.1 on hold due to artifact metadata mismatch (release window in 45m).

deploybot: [system] Promo hold: artifact=gcr.io/redwood/app:20250302-abc123 metadata.git_ref=main vs build_manifest.git_ref=release/v2.4.1. checksum ok. reason: build may have used main when tagging.

alex: Oof. Did the tag point to main at build time? Can we re-run a release build quickly?

maria: Two options:
1) Pin to the last-good image digest and manual-promote (fast, needs QA signoff).
2) Rebuild the release tag (clean, ~30m runtime) — risk missing change window.

jon: Artifacts are in gcr us-central1. Last-good digest I see: sha256:deadbeefcafebabe. We can promote that to staging quickly if we want to unblock.

emma: Given the change window, I'm +1 for pin->promote then rebuild later. Can QA run a smoke test after promote? @qa-team

maria: Agreed. Action: pin to sha256:deadbeefcafebabe and add a note in release notes "pinned image due to manifest git_ref mismatch." Sam, can you do the manual promote?

sam: Doing manual promote now. Commands I'm running:
```
# inspect artifact
gcloud artifacts docker images describe gcr.io/redwood/app@sha256:deadbeefcafebabe

# promote
deploybot promote --artifact gcr.io/redwood/app@sha256:deadbeefcafebabe --to staging --by sam
```

deploybot: Manual promote started by sam. Promotion -> staging: SUCCESS :white_check_mark: (timestamp 1735012485)

alex: Thanks. Also raising a follow-up to add a CI gating check: fail if build_manifest.git_ref != tag_ref. Filed https://github.com/redwood/issues/1234

jon: I'll add an alert for artifact metadata drift to eng-sre. 

sam: Release unblocked, closing this thread. I'll file a short post-mortem in #postmortems and include the pinned-notes. :rocket:
